hero.title: File:Buckeye-Gillespie Dam Bridge Marker.JPG
hero.description: The historic Gillespie Dam Bridge marker. The historic Gillespie Dam Bridge was built in 1927 over the Gila River and is located on Old Highway 80 north of Gila Bend and south of Arlington between the Buckeye Hills and the Gila Bend Mountains in Maricopa County.  The bridge was at the time the longest highway bridge in the state of Arizona. The bridge was listed on the National Register of Historic Places on May 5, 1981, reference #81000136

gallery.title: File:Buckeye-Gillespie Dam-1921.JPG
gallery.description: The Gillespie Dam was constructed in 1921. The dam is a concrete gravity dam located on the Gila River between the towns of Buckeye and Gila Bend, Arizona. On the morning of January 9, 1993, the dam failed when a segment approximately 120 feet (37 m) in length collapsed into the Gila River.
